title: Condor 1-Drum Low-Profile Modular Polyethylene Spill Deck with Drain (15-Gallon Sump, 2,000 lb Capacity)
description: The CONDOR 1633BDC spill deck is a low-profile secondary spill containment platform configured for use with one 55-gallon drum and rated for 15 gal spill containment capacity. Made of black polyethylene, this uncovered modular unit is intended for indoor use and has a 2,000 lb load capacity. It provides a 26 1/4 in x 26 1/4 in platform with 15 gal containment capacity below the drum. Key Features: Product type: Spill deck for secondary spill containment Spill capacity: 15 gal Drum capacity: Holds 1 standard 55-gallon drum Load rating: 2,000 lb Material: Polyethylene construction with black pallet and grate Profile: Low-profile design with 6 1/2 in height Dimensions: 26 1/4 in L x 26 1/4 in W x 6 1/2 in H Configuration: Uncovered, modular design with no doors and no cover Drain: Includes drain for liquid removal Handling: No forklift pockets Connection: Compatible with ramp connection model 1689BC Use: Indoor use Standard: EPA 40 CFR 264.175
